title: Redis Agent Persistence Layer — 72h TTL with Auto-Renewal
content: Agents persist in Upstash Redis via kudbee:agents:{id} hash keys with 259200s (72h) TTL. The kudbee:agents:index SET tracks all registered agents. Three defense layers prevent expiry: (1) session-bootstrap.mjs renews all agent TTLs on every session start, (2) agent-expiry-guard.mjs runs check/renew/repop on-demand or via cron, (3) local .kilo/agents/*.agent files serve as golden source for re-registration if Redis keys vanish. Use UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN to access the REST API. Commands: node scripts/agent-expiry-guard.mjs check|renew|repop|full.
